prompt:
Photograph of a 17th-century sea captain's cabin in the stern of a
galleon, warm and cluttered, lit by daylight from the stern windows. Low
wooden ceiling beams run across the top of the picture. Two stern windows look out on the blue sea. On the
upper left wall, two crossed swords; below them, on a small shelf, a
thick leather-bound log book. On the left, an iron-bound wooden sea
chest. A brass telescope stands on a tripod left of centre. At the back
centre, a bed with heavy dark red curtains. In the middle, a wooden
table with sea charts and maps spread on it. At the bottom left of
centre, a large antique globe on a wooden stand. On the right, a tall
dark wooden chest of drawers with a mirror above it. At the bottom
right, a pair of tall leather sea boots standing on the floor. No
people. Historical reenactment photography, wide lens, sharp focus,
realistic. Style: one consistent look for the whole series, photographed like a
period film still of the 1660s Caribbean, natural warm light, gentle
film grain, muted rich colours with warm amber and deep teal tones,
moderate contrast, shallow depth of field, realistic textures, no text.
source: layout from the game's spot rectangles
